title: An end-to-end workflow: from data to PDF
text: ’ll use syndromic_alert, template built “observed value crossed threshold baseline” (see package README differs four built-templates). real syndromic surveillance system use validated algorithm (EWMA, Serfling, regression/EWMA switch standard choices, per CDC’s guidance). vignette, ’ll use something much simpler fully transparent: month, compare mean standard deviation trailing 12 months, compute z-score. deliberately naive; doesn’t account seasonality way real algorithm , ’s enough find genuinely interesting month real data without hiding calculation . largest anomaly dataset simple measure July 1977: 2.59 standard deviations trailing 12-month baseline. ’s real, notable jump (cherry-picked drama; ’s genuinely single largest deviation across 72 months), consistent real seasonal pattern accidental deaths (outdoor travel activity summer).
code: n <- length(deaths) z_scores <- rep(NA_real_, n) for (i in 13:n) {   baseline_window <- deaths[(i - 12):(i - 1)]   z_scores[i] <- (deaths[i] - mean(baseline_window)) / sd(baseline_window) }  alert_index <- which.max(z_scores) observed <- deaths[alert_index] baseline_window <- deaths[(alert_index - 12):(alert_index - 1)] baseline_mean <- mean(baseline_window) z <- z_scores[alert_index]  cat(sprintf(   "Largest anomaly: index %d, observed %d, baseline mean %.1f, z = %.2f\n",   alert_index, observed, baseline_mean, z )) #> Largest anomaly: index 55, observed 10625, baseline mean 8422.8, z = 2.59

what: Verifying contrast before you ship a color change
title: Theming: colors and logos
text: part ’s easy skip genuinely shouldn’t . Every color onepagr’s built-themes verified WCAG’s real contrast formula, chosen eye, color looks readable thing color measures 4.5:1. onepagr doesn’t yet ship automated checker (check_theme_contrast() planned, -yet-built function), now manual step, using formula package’s development used: Check every foreground/background pairing new color actually appears , text size ’s actually used (text-box section label small text needs 4.5:1; 28pt stat-card number large text needs 3:1). project’s default.typ uk.typ theme files real, first-hand examples color passed one size failed another; files’ comments explain exactly pairing failed .
code: wcag_contrast <- function(hex1, hex2) {   linearize <- function(channel) {     channel <- channel / 255     ifelse(channel <= 0.03928, channel / 12.92, ((channel + 0.055) / 1.055)^2.4)   }   relative_luminance <- function(hex) {     rgb <- grDevices::col2rgb(hex)     lin <- linearize(rgb)     0.2126 * lin[1] + 0.7152 * lin[2] + 0.0722 * lin[3]   }   l1 <- relative_luminance(hex1)   l2 <- relative_luminance(hex2)   (max(l1, l2) + 0.05) / (min(l1, l2) + 0.05) }  # Example: is a purple accent readable as small text on a light card # background? WCAG needs >= 4.5 for normal text, >= 3 for large text # (18pt+ regular or 14pt+ bold). wcag_contrast("#6A4C93", "#EDE7F6") #> [1] 5.659206

title: Render a onepagr one-pager to PDF — render_onepager
text: data Named list whisker substitution values. alert-style templates (overdose_spike_alert, syndromic_alert), severity_level token must literal lowercase string "warning" "critical", show_* toggle token (e.g. show_resources, show_cluster) must literal lowercase string "true" "false". substituted directly Typst string comparisons, R logical (whisker coerces "TRUE"/"FALSE", uppercase) value fails compile loudly Typst panic() rather silently rendering wrong severity styling mis-toggled section. template Character. built-template name (see list_templates()). theme Character. built-theme name, path custom theme .typ file (see resolve_theme()). Default "default". theme_path Character NULL. Explicit theme file path override; supplied, theme ignored. Default NULL. output Character. Path write compiled PDF . keep_typst Logical. Whether leave resolved .typ tree next output (TRUE, default) use disposable tempdir (FALSE). extra_assets Character vector file paths stage compile work directory alongside theme/components/package assets – per-run generated images (e.g. charts/maps produced fresh calling script) template's #image() calls need reference. Typst's compiler sandboxes file access directory compiled rejects absolute filesystem paths outright (confirmed directly: #image("C:/abs/path/map.png") fails compile "path contains invalid component" even fixing Windows backslashes forward slashes – path-syntax issue, Typst permit escaping compile root ). file copied basename (overwriting conflict); pass just basename corresponding whisker token's value (e.g. extra_assets = "path//map0.png" pairs template token value "map0.png", original full path). Default character(0) (extra assets, e.g. templates whose images static package assets). font_dir Character NULL. Passed compile_typst()'s font_dir argument – directory font files make available compile, addition system fonts, theme's text-font/heading-font tokens name font installed system-wide (e.g. Posit Workbench deployment without permission install fonts OS level). Default NULL.

title: onepagr 0.1.0
text: render_onepager(): render named list values finished, accessible PDF using built-template theme. export_template(): copy built-template’s full source project exploration hand-editing. compile_typst(): low-level primitive underlying ; compiles .typ file whisker-substituted data. check_quarto() / install_quarto(): detect , request, install Quarto/Typst toolchain onepagr depends . list_templates() / list_themes() / resolve_template() / resolve_theme(): built-template theme registry. fmt_n() / fmt_pct(): number-formatting helpers matching convention every built-template’s tokens expect. Logos data, template edits: every template takes primary logo (always shown) plus two independently toggleable partner logos (show_partner_a/show_partner_b), single organization, two-agency partnership, three-organization lockup first-class cases. render_onepager()’s font_dir argument makes directory font files available Typst compile, theme font isn’t installed system-wide.

title: onepagr 0.1.0
text: Five built-templates, genuinely distinct informational shape: cohort_summary: contrasts two groups point time. trend_snapshot: tracks one metric across several time periods. overdose_spike_alert: anomaly/threshold alert bulletin (ODMAP-style), natural pagination. syndromic_alert: anomaly/threshold alert syndrome (ESSENCE-style), natural pagination. county_choropleth: geographic bivariate comparison across counties, supports per-run generated map images via extra_assets.

title: onepagr 0.1.0
text: default: brand-neutral palette built Bootstrap 5.3’s color variables. uk: University Kentucky / KIPRC branding. Every built-template theme combination verified Typst’s --pdf-standard ua-1 compile-time check real PAC (PDF Accessibility Checker) run covering PDF/UA WCAG tabs.
